summary: Insurance Product Information Document issued by DKV Luxembourg S.A. for the HOSPITAL HEALTH tariff, a Private Health Insurance. It is additional protection for inpatient treatment without aging reserves. Cover concerns inpatient treatment (medical treatment, chief physician, accommodation, ambulance transport, hospital daily benefit) plus the optional Best Care Premium service, and applies to Europe.

duration_and_cancellation.duration: Insurance cover commences in accordance with the time period stated in the policy document (commencement of insurance); however, not before the insurance contract has been concluded, i.e. not before the insurance policy has been signed by both contractual partners and not before the termination of waiting periods. Insurance cover ends – including any insurance claims which may be still pending – when the insurance contract is terminated.
duration_and_cancellation.notice_period: Period of notice to cancel the insurance contract is 30 days
methods: Cancellation must be effected in writing
special_rights: The policyholder can contest the automatic renewal of the insurance contract by notifying the insurance company with effect at the end of the insurance year, however, not before termination of the second insurance year at the earliest
As a policyholder, you may limit the cancelation of the insurance to a single insured person in your insurance contract
The cancellation is only valid provided that the policyholder can prove that the insured persons affected by this were informed of notification to cancel
In some situations, you might have an extraordinary cancellation right, e.g. if premium contributions are subject to an increase

Insurance cover is terminated, for example; in case of: Cancellation of the insurance contract; Death of the insured person; Non-compliance with the requirements of a risk/person to be insured stipulated in the tariff conditions

notes: The first instalment/premium payment must be paid at the latest immediately after the insurance policy has been given to the policy holder, however, not before the inception date of insurance cover indicated on the insurance policy
All other premiums are due, depending on the agreed method of payment, at the beginning of the agreed contribution period

Premium payment can be effected via bank transfer or via direct debit mandate in favor of the insurer. Should you opt for monthly instalments, it is indispensable to arrange for a direct debit mandate in favor of the insurer
In some situations, you might have an extraordinary cancellation right, e.g. if premium contributions are subject to an increase

gaps: edition_date: null — the document prints NO edition/version date and no reference code. The whole text layer was searched for date and version patterns: no hit. The PDF metadata carry a creation date (2018-10-12) and the InDesign file name 'IPID_HOSPITAL HEALTH_EN.indd', but that is metadata, not print, and was therefore NOT used as edition_date.

Polarity of the lists: the markers are BITMAP IMAGES, neither text nor vector drawings — get_text() and get_drawings() return nothing for them. Page 1 holds 24 image markers, assigned by size and x-position: 14 green ticks (7.16 × 7.94 pt, x0 = 65.1) = 'What is insured ?', 6 red crosses (7.16 × 7.22 pt, x0 = 342.7) = 'What is not insured ?', 4 orange exclamation marks (2.39 × 8.87 pt, x0 = 344.7) = 'Are there any restrictions on cover ?'. The arithmetic closes exactly: 14 + 6 + 4 = 24 images = 14 + 6 + 4 extracted items. Marker shape and colour were confirmed on a 6× render of a sibling document built from the same template. These facts cannot appear in key_quotes: they are not in the text layer.

Column-inversion check NEGATIVE on this document, and it needed care: the y-ranges of the two columns overlap heavily (a tick at y = 369.5 and a cross at y = 369.5), yet the flat text emits the whole left column before the right one, with no interleaving. Attachment was nevertheless rebuilt marker by marker on the abscissa. A first pass of the matcher, which only required the text to start to the right of the marker, mis-attached the four 'Best Care Premium' ticks to right-column lines; constraining the candidate to the SAME column (text start within 40 pt of the marker) fixed it. Worth recording because the wrong version still looked plausible.

'Optional service: Best Care Premium' is expressly labelled optional in the document; its four items carry is_optional = true. The document says nothing about optionality for any other item, so those carry is_optional = false.
The length of the waiting periods is never stated; waiting_periods.duration stays null.

target_audience: null. The document describes the product ('Additional protection for inpatient treatment without aging reserves') but never names a customer category. Per the repo rule, the field is not deduced from the product type; the document's own wording is in target_audience_note.
The document states no deductible/franchise, no prescription period and no claims procedure; deductibles, prescription_period and claims_procedure stay empty.

Spelling kept verbatim as printed, not corrected: 'Accomodation costs' (one m) in the first item against 'Additional costs for accommodation' (two m) three lines below, and 'coinsured children'. The repo rule forbids correcting the insurer's typos.

Text-layer trap check: no zero-width spaces, no soft hyphens, no NFD combining accents, no PUA glyphs, no U+0007, no text outside the page rectangle, no stacked headers. The € glyph survived extraction (1 occurrence) and was not reconstructed. The footer separator uses a thin space U+2009 ('Product : HOSPITAL HEALTH').
The risk carrier is named in the document: 'DKV Luxembourg S.A.' (page 1 footer, with legal form). No third party (claims handler, assistance company, broker) is named anywhere.
The PyMuPDF re-extraction performed here is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the text supplied in the prompt (5418 = 5418 characters); the text was not truncated.
